title: AI coding tools earn above-average points
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Stories about Cursor, Claude Code, MCP, Copilot and Devin get more points than the average story.
expect: If true, points per AI coding story should be at least 1.2x the points of the average story in the same months, across all of 2006 to 2026 (1.05x is weak, 0.8x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story against the same-month average

group_a.label: Cursor, Claude Code, MCP, Copilot and Devin stories ({from} to {to})

group_b.label: Average story of the same months ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Exploratory. Thresholds copied from the card this one replaces.
